report.summary: Chunk 12 of drift.py: builds DriftItem list for islands, unknown, shims, engine disagreements, now-reached, vanished, dark switches, unparsable, doc drift, and ignore config drift.

handoff.purpose: Assemble DriftItem list for various drift categories.

claims.text: the finding a reader gets has to say WHICH kind of unreached this is, because the three remedies are three different sentences
claims.why: Code produces items with distinct kind (NEW_UNKNOWN, NEW_SHIM, TEST_ONLY) and distinct detail/remedy, so reader sees different kinds.

claims.text: What they share is the property that used to be missing entirely -- a module nothing reaches is COUNTED, is named, and blocks until somebody explains it.
claims.why: The chunk does not show that items block; only shows items appended. Blocking behavior not in chunk.

claims.text: it was reachable in the snapshot and is not any more
claims.why: Code sets kind = BECAME_ISLAND if was_reached and mod not in known_unreached, and detail matches.

claims.text: nothing reaches it from any entrypoint, and no test imports it either
claims.why: Code sets kind = NEW_ISLAND when was_reached is False, detail matches.

claims.text: nothing reaches it from any entry point; the only thing that names it is a string literal, or an import in a place where the import is no proof anything runs it
claims.why: Code assigns this string as detail for unknown items.

claims.text: a module that only re-exports, and nothing reaches it from any entry point -- it forwards for nobody
claims.why: Code assigns this string as detail for shim items.

claims.text: was covered by a test in the snapshot; nothing touches it at all now
claims.where: detail inside for loop for baselined mods
claims.why: Code appends item with this detail when mod in baselined and mod not in new_test_only and mod in old_test_only.

claims.text: nothing reaches it from any entry point; only its own tests import it
claims.where: detail for TEST_ONLY inside for loop
claims.why: Code appends item with this detail when mod in new_test_only.

claims.text: the structural index has this import edge and the reachability walk does not. It is reported, never merged: merging it is how a dead-branch import used to make its target 'reachable'
claims.why: Code uses this detail for each edge in new_index_extra - old_index_extra.

claims.text: nothing reached it in the snapshot; something reaches it now
claims.why: Code appends item with this detail for mod in old_set & new_modules and not in new_unreached.

claims.text: in the snapshot, not on disk
claims.why: Code appends item with this detail for mod in old_modules - new_modules.

claims.text: off-by-default env gate at {sites.get(...)}, introduced in no document
claims.why: Code constructs detail with f-string using result.sites.get.

claims.text: could not be parsed, so it contributed no imports and no switches to this run
claims.why: Code appends item with this detail for mod in new_unparsable - old_unparsable.

claims.text: the code reads it; no document mentions it
documented, but no code reads it any more
the docs and the code name it two different ways
claims.why: Code uses this string as fallback for .get(side, ...).

claims.text: An ABSENT key reads as 'nothing was excluded', not as 'do not check'. Deleting the field must not be a quieter way to narrow the run than setting the variable was.
claims.why: Code defaults old_ignore to {'env': '', 'file': ''} when not a dict, ensuring absent key is treated as empty exclusion, not skip.

claims.text: the baseline was taken under {_describe_ignore(old_ignore)}. A run that looks at less of the tree than the baseline did cannot be compared with it, and a green result from one must never be indistinguishable from a green result from the other
claims.why: Code constructs detail with _describe_ignore(old_ignore) and uses this string.

observations.what: Loop variables list_key, prefix, kind, old_set, why are used but list_key is not used in the loop body (only in comment).
observations.where: for list_key, prefix, kind, old_set, why in (...) at line ~1340

observations.what: Variable 'baselined' computed as old_set & old_modules but old_set is not defined in the outer scope; it is the loop variable from the for loop. The code is correct but readability could be improved.
The comment 'the other two unreached classes' refers to unknown and shims, but islands are also unreached. The comment says 'three kinds' but only two are listed; islands handled earlier.
